title: You Think Meditation Just Relaxes You, Yet Monks Fire 30-Fold Brain Gamma Waves
description:
You think meditation just puts a tired brain to sleep! Yet monks generated the strongest waking brain waves ever recorded! This is the true story of Richard Davidson's Monk Gamma Study. Here is what went wrong with the myth of passive rest.
